privacy.ai_training_note: Privacy policy states collected information is used to 'Develop, operate, improve, maintain, protect and provide the features and functionality of the Services, including to train our artificial intelligence/machine learning models.' The Captions terms grant Mirage a 'limited, nonexclusive, royalty-free, sublicensable license in your Input and Output' to host, cache, store, reproduce, modify, distribute and use content to provide, improve, and develop new services and products. No affirmative opt-in consent gate or opt-out mechanism for model training is described in the public documentation; agreement is via acceptance of the Terms.

products.data_scope: Video files, user-generated content, usage data

products.name: Avatar Generation

flags: A third-party security aggregator (Nudge Security) lists extensive certifications (PCI, HIPAA, ISO 27001, FedRamp, CSA STAR Level 1) that are not corroborated by the vendor's own published pages; this may reflect outdated aggregator data, incomplete public disclosure by the vendor, or aggregator error.
Privacy policy states collected information is used to train Mirage's AI/ML models; no affirmative consent gate or opt-out mechanism for training is described in the available documentation.
HIPAA BAA referenced as available but not standard; organizations handling PHI must execute BAA before use.
